description:
Flour Covered Home creates warm, personality-filled wall art inspired by baking, coffee, home, pets, and the everyday moments that make a space feel special. 

Our Brand Ambassador Program is designed for creators who genuinely connect with home decor and lifestyle content. Ambassadors earn 15% commission on qualifying sales, receive a unique referral link and coupon code, and can offer their audience 10% off. 

Approved ambassadors also receive complimentary artwork to feature in their content. We welcome authentic creators who enjoy sharing beautiful spaces, meaningful decor, and products their audience will genuinely connect with.
payout_period: Approved commissions are paid weekly after our 30-day return period ends, typically within 7 days.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to the Flour Covered Home Brand Ambassador Program! We’re excited to partner with creators who love sharing beautiful spaces, baking, coffee, home decor, and the little things that make a home feel special.

By joining the Flour Covered Home Brand Ambassador Program (“Program”), you agree to the following terms.

1. Joining the Program

All Brand Ambassador applications are reviewed by Flour Covered Home. Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance, and we reserve the right to approve or decline applications at our discretion.

Ambassadors must be at least 18 years old.

Participation in the Program does not create an employment relationship, partnership, or agency relationship with Flour Covered Home.

2. Your Referral Link & Discount Code

Approved Ambassadors will receive a unique referral link and/or discount code to share with their audience.

You may promote Flour Covered Home through social media, websites, blogs, email newsletters, videos, and other content you create.

Please do not:

  • Use your own referral link or code to generate commission on personal purchases.
  • Post your code on coupon, cashback, deal, or discount-code websites without our permission.
  • Create unauthorized Flour Covered Home discounts or promotions.
  • Misrepresent Flour Covered Home products, pricing, or promotions.
  • Attempt to manipulate referral tracking or commissions.

If more than one Ambassador link or code is involved in a purchase, our referral system will determine which Ambassador receives the commission.

3. Commission

Ambassadors earn the commission rate shown in their Ambassador Dashboard for qualifying purchases made through their referral link or code.

Commission is calculated on the eligible product subtotal and does not include taxes, shipping charges, refunded amounts, gift card purchases, or other non-commissionable charges.

Orders that are canceled, returned, refunded, disputed, fraudulent, or charged back do not qualify for commission.

4. Getting Paid

Approved commissions become eligible for payment after our 30-day return period, including any applicable cancellation and refund review, has passed. Eligible commissions are then paid on the next weekly payout date, typically within 7 days.

Payment details and the current payment schedule will be available through your Ambassador Dashboard.

Ambassadors are responsible for providing accurate payment information and for any taxes or reporting requirements associated with the commissions they receive.

5. Referral Tracking

Flour Covered Home uses referral links, discount codes, cookies, and other tracking technology to attribute purchases to Ambassadors.

The current cookie period is displayed on the Program registration page and/or Ambassador Dashboard.

Tracking may not work if a customer clears or blocks cookies, changes devices or browsers, uses another Ambassador's link or code, or otherwise prevents the referral from being tracked.

Commission can only be issued for purchases successfully attributed to you through the Program.

6. Be Transparent With Your Audience

We want your Flour Covered Home content to feel natural and authentic.

Because you may earn commission or receive other benefits through the Program, you must clearly disclose your relationship with Flour Covered Home when promoting our products.

Examples include:

“Flour Covered Home Brand Ambassador”
“I may earn a commission if you purchase through my link.”
#ad or #affiliate

Please follow applicable FTC endorsement guidelines and the disclosure requirements of the social media platforms you use.

Most importantly, only share genuine opinions and experiences. Do not make false or misleading claims about Flour Covered Home or claim to have purchased, received, used, or experienced a product if you have not.

7. Creating & Sharing Content

We encourage you to create content in your own voice and style.

You remain the owner of the original photos, videos, captions, reviews, and other content you create.

When you tag Flour Covered Home, submit content to us, or create content specifically as part of the Brand Ambassador Program, you give Flour Covered Home permission to repost and share that content through our:

  • Website and product pages
  • Organic social media accounts
  • Email marketing
  • Other Flour Covered Home-owned marketing channels

We may make reasonable formatting changes such as cropping, resizing, adding captions, or adapting content for different platforms.

Paid Advertising: By participating in the Brand Ambassador Program, you also give Flour Covered Home permission to use Ambassador Content in paid digital advertising for up to 12 months from the date the content is first used in an advertisement. This may include your name, social media handle, image, voice, or likeness when they are part of the original content. You retain ownership of your content, and we will not materially alter it in a way that misrepresents you or your endorsement of Flour Covered Home.

You retain ownership of your original content.

8. Using Flour Covered Home Content

We may provide product photos, videos, logos, graphics, or other materials for you to use when promoting Flour Covered Home.

These materials remain the property of Flour Covered Home and may only be used to promote Flour Covered Home as part of the Program.

Please do not alter our artwork, product images, branding, or other materials in a way that inaccurately represents our products or brand.

9. Complimentary Products

From time to time, Flour Covered Home may offer complimentary or discounted products to selected Ambassadors.

Joining the Program does not guarantee free products.

If you receive a complimentary or discounted product, please disclose that relationship when required by FTC guidelines or platform rules.

10. Program Changes & Ending Participation

We may occasionally update Program details such as commission rates, discount offers, cookie duration, payment schedules, or these Terms.

Important changes will be communicated through the Ambassador Dashboard, email, or another Program communication.

Flour Covered Home may suspend or remove an Ambassador for fraud, misleading advertising, failure to make required disclosures, misuse of referral links or discount codes, or other violations of these Terms.

You may leave the Program at any time by contacting us.

After leaving the Program, please stop representing yourself as a current Flour Covered Home Brand Ambassador.

11. Questions

We're happy to help with questions about the Flour Covered Home Brand Ambassador Program.

Contact us at:

support@flourcoveredhome.com

By submitting your application and participating in the Program, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to these Terms & Conditions.

We're excited to have you as part of the Flour Covered Home community and can't wait to see what you create!
